proposed_change: Original Earth/Cryo spatial expert only: separate P/S GaussianProcessClassifier with Constant*Matern1.5; train-only coordinate scaling and LML hyperparameter fit, same .5 blend.
reason: No new input information; prior local residual diagnostics, 5-vs-9-knot comparison and common-order coordinate replacement gave little evidence of remaining smooth spatial structure. Learning LML is not a guarantee of accuracy/logloss improvement.
limit: Evidence lowers priority, does not prove every GP model ineffective. Resource size is feasible, not the reason for rejection.
